sql: SELECT event_order,event_id,user_id,entity_type,entity_id,action,status,recorded_at,CASE WHEN after_json IS NOT NULL THEN json_object('id',json_extract(after_json,'$.id'),'set_uuid',json_extract(after_json,'$.set_uuid'),'session_id',json_extract(after_json,'$.session_id'),'ended_at',json_extract(after_json,'$.ended_at'),'started_at',json_extract(after_json,'$.started_at'),'completion_state',json_extract(after_json,'$.completion_state'),'set_type',json_extract(after_json,'$.set_type'),'session_exercise_id',json_extract(after_json,'$.session_exercise_id'),'deleted_at',json_extract(after_json,'$.deleted_at'),'session_status',json_extract(after_json,'$.session_status'),'sets',coalesce(json_extract(after_json,'$.sets'),json('[]'))) END AS after_json,result_json FROM (WITH selected AS (SELECT rowid AS event_order,* FROM training_event WHERE user_id=? AND julianday(recorded_at)<=julianday(?)+0.001/86400 AND (CASE WHEN entity_type='session' THEN json_extract(after_json,'$.id') ELSE json_extract(after_json,'$.session_id') END) IN (SELECT value FROM json_each(?))) SELECT * FROM selected UNION ALL SELECT e.rowid AS event_order,e.* FROM training_event e JOIN training_conflict c ON c.id=e.entity_id AND c.user_id=e.user_id WHERE e.user_id=? AND e.entity_type='conflict' AND c.event_id IN (SELECT event_id FROM selected) AND e.event_id NOT IN (SELECT event_id FROM selected) AND julianday(e.recorded_at)<=julianday(?)+0.001/86400)
